notes: Initial course runs each have 14 passes and one locate-retry test-expectation failure. The original assertion failed identically in same-version Chromium isolation while the initial WebKit run was still active.

The test expected generic multiple-choice retry to clear selection. Source handlers show custom locate input preserves selection and clicking sets a value; it does not toggle off. After both initial runners finished, only the expected state was changed to retained aria-pressed and enabled check. Both engines passed the full affected retry test; no application, timeout or threshold was changed.

All account tests use account-test-version.json. Later only optional reference caption/headings and corresponding input metadata changed; exact differences are recorded in reference-refinement.json and reference-version-diff.json. Complete reference source/layout checks pass on both engines; unrelated account paths are reused. Chromium account mounts ran in parallel, one worker each. WebKit account mounts ran sequentially, one worker; no other browser test runner was active then.

Unit/workflow checks and the two sequential build jobs overlapped with the first WebKit account run. Normal in-app preview and four cover viewport checks are separately documented; no answers or stars were supplied in that preview.
Catalog and deployment checks ran after the account matrix. Repeated representative and corrected-assertion runs are not added to the 66 distinct successful conditions.
The first PDF already contained two complete pages; no spacing/line-count reduction or new print refinement was required. Only the original 25-line worksheet output is delivered.

Four-width cover evidence predates the optional reference-label correction; cover content and CSS were unchanged. Authenticated reference-preview.jpg and final preview.jpg were captured after the normal course reload showed the final labels; zero stars and word page 1/2 remained unchanged.
